identification: Louisa Anne Meredith, 'Our Island Home: A Tasmanian Sketch Book', Hobart J. Walch / London Marcus Ward, 1879, folio, original pictorial cloth with pine-cone gilt design. Photos show autotype plates Hobart Town from Proctor's Road, South Arm, Herne Bay, Wine-glass Bay, Cape Raoul. Spine worn and frayed at head and tail, cover rubbed, foxing on plate margins, front pastedown covered in pasted glider newspaper clippings (1930s Tasmanian gliding), board edge damage. Plates look reasonably clean. Plate count unknown.

viewing_check: Count the plates against the 13 tinted autotype plates (incl. additional title) and check for missing or loose plates and the title page and date. Check hinges and whether boards are detached, the extent of foxing, and what the pasted clippings have done to the pastedown (removal not possible). A complete, sound copy points to the $600 to $950 range; missing plates or detached boards drops it sharply.
